testsuite.name: com.aquinofroilan.tessera.domain.auth.controller.AuthControllerTest

testcase.name: POST forgot-password should return 400 when email is blank()
POST signup should return 400 when email format is invalid()
POST refresh should return 200 with new tokens when refresh token is valid()
POST signup should return 400 when email already exists()
POST signup should return 400 when username is blank()
POST logout should return 200 when no authorization header is provided()
POST signin should return 401 when user account is inactive()
POST logout should return 200 when authorization header has invalid format()
GET organizations should return org list for authenticated user()
POST refresh should return 400 when refresh token field is blank()
POST signin should return 400 when username is blank()
POST forgot-password should return 200 regardless of email existence()
POST signin should return 400 when password is blank()
POST signin should return 401 when credentials are invalid()
POST organizations switch should return new token pair()
POST organizations switch should return 400 for unauthorized org()
POST signup should return 400 when password is too short()
POST forgot-password should throttle repeated requests for same email()
POST logout should return 200 when authorization header is empty()
POST logout should invoke authService logout with valid token()
POST signup should return 400 when username already exists()
POST reset-password should return 200 with valid token()
POST signin should return 200 with tokens when login is successful()
POST logout should return 200 when token is valid()
POST signup should return 201 when registration is successful()
POST reset-password should return 400 with invalid token()
POST refresh should return 401 when refresh token is invalid()
POST reset-password should return 400 when password is too short()
